messages:
sam: CI linkcheck failing on main -> migration-guide/k8s.md anchor broken. looks like a multibyte char in the heading (an em‑dash) is slugified differently by docusaurus. linkcheck shows: '...#install%E2%80%94agent not found'. can someone grab?

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck job failed on docs-main (build 987). 1 broken anchor. full log: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/987/logs/linkcheck

maria: I can take this. quick glance: the heading is `### Install the Redwood agent — Helm chart` and the slug becomes `install%E2%80%94agent` instead of `install-agent`. two options: add an explicit header id, or normalize the char to a plain hyphen. i prefer explicit id so we preserve wording.

lee: +1 to explicit id. less invasive. Docusaurus supports the `{#id}` syntax, right?

maria: yep. i'll open a tiny PR to add `{#install-agent}` and also tidy a malformed Python snippet in that page that had a stray leading space breaking the fenced block rendering. will include changelog entry and a short note in the migration-guide.

sam: thanks. do we need to whitelist this anchor in linkcheck? or will the explicit id fix it?

maria: explicit id fixes it, but i'll also add a one-line test to docs/linkcheck-allowlist.txt in case other multibyte headings slip through during migration. we should keep allowlist minimal though.

lee: can you paste the exact patch here so I can review quickly?

maria: sure. patch excerpt: ```diff
-### Install the Redwood agent — Helm chart
+### Install the Redwood agent — Helm chart {#install-agent}
@@
-```python
-  from redwood import Client
-  client = Client()
-```
+```python
+from redwood import Client
+client = Client()
+```
```

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4825 — small edit + linkcheck allowlist update. tagging @lee for review.

lee: reviewing now. tiny nits: replace the em‑dash with a normal hyphen in the H2 permalinks doc example to avoid copy-paste footguns, but keep the page heading as-is with id.

sam: do we need to run full site build locally before merging? linkcheck output can be flaky.

maria: i'll run mkdocs/docusaurus locally and push the green CI before merge. if build passes I'll merge and then run a spot check on staging.

ci-bot: PR 4825: linkcheck job passed on branch 'fix/multibyte-heading' (build 992).

lee: LGTM, merging once CI confirms. thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

sam: nice. can we add a short note to the docs migration checklist to scan for non-ascii punctuation in headings? noticed we keep hitting this during localization imports.

maria: added a checklist item in the repo: docs/maintenance/migration-checklist.md — 'normalize/explicit-id multibyte punctuation in headings'. will follow up with a tiny grep script next week to surface candidates.

sam: perfect. closing thread.
